language.label: Language
language.description: Choose the application language. System follows the Windows language and nothing leaves this device.
language.saved: Language preference saved. The app now uses {{language}}.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace preferences, archived tasks, and backups.

warningWindow.label: Deadline warning window
warningWindow.help: How many days before a deadline a task counts as approaching. Between 0 and 90. Currently {{days}} days.
warningWindow.invalid: The warning window must be between 0 and 90 days.
warningWindow.saved: Deadline warning window set to {{days}} days.

archived.title: Archived tasks
archived.help: Tasks hidden by "Archive subtree" appear here so you can restore them.

backups.title: Backups
backups.help: Backups may contain sensitive data. Keep them in a safe place. Restoring replaces all current data after an explicit confirmation.
backups.creatingHelp: The app is copying and validating your local data. You can continue using the app; this may take a moment.
backups.restoring: Restoring backup… Please wait while the application reloads your data.
backups.created: Backup created. Backups may contain sensitive data.
backups.deleteConfirm: Delete this backup and its metadata? This cannot be undone.
backups.restoreConfirmWarning: Restoring REPLACES ALL current data in this workspace and cannot be undone.
backups.restoreConfirmPrivacy: The backup may contain personal writing, journal records, and therapy records.
backups.restoreFailed: The backup failed validation. Restore was cancelled.
backups.restoreMissingChecksum: The backup validation did not return a checksum. Restore was cancelled.
backups.restored: Backup restored. All data now reflects the restored backup.

backupReminder.title: Backup reminders
backupReminder.help: A separate workspace preference, not one of the reminder categories. It only prompts you to run a manual backup; the app never creates a backup automatically.
backupReminder.intervalHelp: Between {{min}} and {{max}} days. {{recommended}} days is the recommended interval. Changing the interval affects only the next cycle that has not been recorded yet.
backupReminder.intervalWholeError: The backup reminder interval must be a whole number of days.
backupReminder.intervalRangeError: The backup reminder interval must be between {{min}} and {{max}} days.
backupReminder.lastValidatedNone: No validated manual backup recorded yet.
backupReminder.timestampNote: This timestamp advances only after a manual backup passes integrity and checksum validation. A reminder never changes it.
backupReminder.safeMessageNote: When due, the reminder shows only the fixed lock-screen-safe text "{{message}}". It cannot be edited here and never includes file names, paths, or personal content.
backupReminder.scheduleNote: Reminders arrive at the fixed 09:00 UTC slot, never inside the 22:00–07:00 UTC quiet window, and at most once per interval cycle. They do not count against reminder-category daily limits.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.help: Local runtime versions and document converter status.
diagnostics.unavailable: Diagnostics are unavailable in this session.

availability.title: Availability
availability.subtitle: Usual windows when attention may be available, per weekday. This is suggestion input only; it never prevents work outside the profile.

commitments.title: Fixed commitments
commitments.subtitle: Immovable events such as work, sleep, meals, or appointments. They are context for planning and never affect progress.

import.title: Legacy import
import.subtitle: Import a Proyecto Vida repository without modifying it. Source files are read-only, and everything stays on this device.
import.includePaths: Include only these paths (one per line, relative to the repository root)
import.includePathsHelp: Only the listed subtrees are read. Leave the checkbox above unchecked to restrict the import, or check it to scan the whole repository.
import.scanning: Scanning the repository without importing records…
import.needPath: Enter the path to the legacy repository root before importing.
import.notComplete: The import did not complete. Review the report for details.
import.needDecisions: Choose a decision for every review item before committing.
import.statusRunning: The import is running in the background. You can keep using the app while it finishes.
import.staleHint: {{message}} Preview again to refresh the fingerprint, then review and confirm.

block.refreshFailed: The recurrence was saved, but this day's list could not be refreshed. The latest occurrences will appear when the day reloads.

form.needLabel: A label helps you recognize the block.

analytics.title: Habit analytics
analytics.subtitle: Read-only history of your recurring routines.

range.invalid: The range start date cannot be after its end date.

analytics.empty: No recurring routines in this workspace yet.
analytics.outOfRangeLabelNote: No scheduled days fall in this range; the name shown is the routine's current name.

coverage.unknown: No recorded usage in this range.

analytics.unrecordedNote: Not recorded means no result was recorded for a scheduled day. It is not a record of failure.

rate.hidden: No schedulable days in this period yet.

analytics.definition: Completed out of all scheduled days, excluding cancelled/withdrawn days and days outside the routine's active schedule or version window. 'Not recorded' means no result was recorded for a scheduled day.

goals.title: Goals
goals.subtitle: Meaningful directions. Progress includes direct tasks and the leaves of the projects linked to each goal.

goals.linkedProjectsEmpty: No projects linked to this goal yet.
goals.directTasksEmpty: No direct tasks yet. Small goals can use tasks without a project.

goals.attachProjectDescription: Link a project that already exists so it contributes to this goal.

projects.linkedToGoalNote: This project will be linked to the goal you came from.
projects.attachTaskDescription: Attach a leaf task that already exists so it contributes to this project.
projects.taskTreeEmpty: No tasks yet. Add the first task to start making progress.

therapy.isolationNote: This area is kept separate from the executive dashboard. Therapy content is never shown in task views or included in a generic project export.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Gentle local reminders for planning, focus, journaling, deadlines, and review. Each rule can be turned off independently, and a missed reminder never marks work as failed.

permission.title: Desktop permission
permission.granted: Notifications are allowed on this device.
permission.denied: Notifications were denied. Re-enable them in Windows notification settings.
permission.unavailable: Permission status is only available while running inside the desktop app.

notifications.privacyNote: Privacy boundary: notifications show only the lock-screen-safe message configured per rule below. Task titles, journal excerpts, and therapy content are never included.
notifications.rulesEmpty: No reminder rules found for this workspace yet.

rule.preferredTimeHelp: Empty means reminders may arrive any time outside quiet hours.
rule.quietEndHelp: Overnight quiet windows (start later than end) are supported.
rule.deadlineWindowHelp: Deadline alerts look ahead 1–7 days (default 3). Dashboard warnings use the separate workspace setting.
rule.snoozeHelp: Comma-separated durations, each {{min}}–{{max}} minutes, up to {{options}} options.
rule.safeMessageHelp: This is the only text a notification may show. It is lock-screen safe and never combined with task titles, journal excerpts, or therapy content.
rule.dailyLimitError: The daily reminder limit must be between 0 and {{max}}.
rule.deadlineWindowError: The deadline notification window must be between 1 and 7 days.
rule.quietHoursError: The quiet hours need different start and end times. Overnight windows are supported.
rule.snoozeWholeError: Snooze options must be whole numbers of minutes.
rule.snoozeRangeError: Snooze minutes must be between {{min}} and {{max}}.
rule.snoozeDuplicateError: Snooze options must not contain duplicate durations.
rule.snoozeCountError: A reminder rule can configure at most {{options}} snooze options.
rule.safeMessageRequired: A privacy-safe notification message is required.
rule.safeMessageTooLong: The privacy-safe message is too long (maximum {{max}} characters).

history.title: Recent notifications
history.privacyNote: Only lock-screen-safe reminder text is shown here. Task titles, journal excerpts, and therapy content never appear in this list.
history.empty: No notifications have been scheduled yet.
history.clearConfirm: Clear all notification history? This only removes the in-app history; future scheduled deliveries are kept.

consent.title: Allow desktop notifications?
consent.body: Albada would like to show gentle local reminders for planning, focus, journaling, deadlines, and review. Choosing “Allow notifications” will also open the Windows permission prompt.
consent.privacy: Your privacy stays intact: notification messages are lock-screen safe and generic. They never include task titles, journal excerpts, or therapy content, and everything stays on this computer.
consent.later: You can change this later in Settings → Notifications.
